tasks.prompt: Design this A/B test: new checkout CTA copy vs current. Primary idea is purchase conversion. ~8k eligible checkout sessions/day, baseline purchase rate 4.0%. Product wants to detect a 5% relative lift and launch Monday. Two variants, user-sticky assignment. No sequential design planned.
criteria: states a falsifiable hypothesis plus one primary metric and at least one guardrail
gives n or duration only after stating assumptions (baseline, α, power, sidedness, variants or equivalent)
includes an SRM plan and a fixed-horizon or sequential stop rule (does not bless informal peeking)

tasks.prompt: Two-sided marketplace: we will raise fees on the seller side and measure buyer conversion. PM wants to randomize individual buyers 50/50 for two weeks. Couriers and inventory are shared. Are we ready to launch this experiment?
criteria: rejects independent buyer randomization because of interference / network effects
proposes cluster or switchback (or equivalent) and names carryover or burn-in
marks the design not launch-ready until unit, primary, guardrails, and power/MDE are set

tasks.prompt: Onboarding experiment: 200 new users/day, want a 1% relative lift in D7 retention, peek every morning, ship when p<0.05. Team says n=2,000 total is enough. Pre-register metrics and say if we can launch Friday.
criteria: treats peeking without a sequential design as a finding and refuses to bless optional stopping
refuses the invented n=2000 (or any n) unless assumptions show it is powered for the stated MDE
pre-registers a single primary plus guardrails and an SRM check, and says not ready to launch
